about.page_description: We are Norvyn Motors — two entrepreneurs on a mission.
about.hero_subtitle: We believe the world's best cars aren't yet in every German driveway. We're changing that.
about.why_text: South Korean manufacturers like Genesis, Kia and Hyundai have caught up with — and often surpassed — Europe's premium brands in terms of technology, build quality and features. What's missing: a direct route to Germany. That's exactly the route we're taking.
about.reason_1_desc: Korean vehicles lead in EV drivetrains, driver assistance systems and connected-car features — often years ahead of European competitors.
about.reason_2_desc: What's considered an expensive option in Europe is standard in Korea. Panoramic roof, heated seats, premium sound — included.
about.reason_3_desc: Same quality, lower price. We import directly from South Korea and pass this advantage on to our customers.
about.khodyda_bio: Khodyda knows how to build and run a business. With Café Jobst in Merzig, he proved that entrepreneurial success is not a matter of age. His passion for quality and people drives Norvyn Motors forward.
about.nico_bio: Nico comes from e-commerce and knows exactly how to present and sell products online. With experience in sales and digital marketing, he ensures that Norvyn Motors not only has the best cars — but also gets found.
about.mission_quote: We don't import cars. We import a new way of driving.
about.cta_subtitle: Browse our selection or get in touch with us directly.
